name: Watashi
source:
Shizu is a shy high school student who wishes to change herself. One day, she gathers her will and decides to take action. What will she do?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-january-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
铃原静穗是一名性格内向的高中生，一直希望改变自己。一天，她终于鼓起勇气，决定付诸行动。她会做些什么？

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-january-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
